requirements.title: FRACTION finite nonzero result follows the extended real model
requirements.definition: For finite nonzero X, the result is X times b to the negative e, where b and e are the model radix and exponent for X.

pending.fraction-finite-model-value: Use X=1.0 and compute the expected model value as X / REAL(RADIX(X), KIND(X)); assert FRACTION(X) equals that representable model value and pair it with X=0.0 and an array elemental case so the finite branch is distinguished from the zero branch.

requirements.title: FRACTION maps IEEE NaN and infinity to IEEE NaN results
requirements.definition: If X is an IEEE NaN, the result is that NaN, which provides a portable NaN-class observation but no portable payload-identity oracle in this suite; if X is an IEEE infinity, the result is an IEEE NaN.

pending.fraction-ieee-nan-result-is-nan: Concrete IEEE-profile plan requires IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN for X's kind, constructs a quiet NaN with IEEE_VALUE, calls FRACTION, and checks the result's IEEE class/IEEE_IS_NAN; this observes only that the result is a NaN.
pending.fraction-ieee-nan-identity-no-portable-o: No portable oracle is registered for NaN payload/signaling identity: the source says 'that NaN', but clause 17 support available to this suite does not provide a portable payload-identity comparison for arbitrary NaN values.
pending.fraction-ieee-infinity-yields-nan: Concrete IEEE-profile plan requires IEEE_SUPPORT_INF and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN for X's kind, constructs positive infinity with IEEE_VALUE, calls FRACTION, and asserts IEEE_IS_NAN(FRACTION(inf)).

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.86-16.9.91: EXTENDS_TYPE_OF, FAILED_IMAGES, FINDLOC, FLOOR, FRACTION and GAMMA (batch191). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; EXTENDS_TYPE_OF covers both disassociated-pointer and unallocated-allocatable unlimited polymorphic arguments; FAILED_IMAGES is out of scope; FRACTION of a NaN is planned as 'is a NaN' with NaN identity recorded as having no portable oracle.
